build.beforeBuildCommand: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/webui" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build
build.beforeDevCommand: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/webui" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build

bundle.shortDescription: Find, organize, deduplicate, and archive files in your home directory.
bundle.longDescription: homelinter scans your home directory, suggests safe moves and duplicate deletions, and executes the plan you approve. The service and the SPA run inside this app.
